limitations: The repository contains this summary; raw arrays, logs and local output directories are not tracked by Git.
Only current QEMU 8.2.2 measurements are compared; historical QEMU 11.1.2 timings are not used.
France comparisons use eight tokens. KV includes first session startup; no-KV includes all eight QEMU launches.
The first KV case also includes the initial checkpoint written after startup; writes after case completion and final terminal display are excluded.
cli_elapsed_s comes from the outer measurement wrapper and includes the final report write, unlike report.elapsed_seconds sampled just before that write.
The no-KV to KV comparison includes resident QEMU and single-position projection/output, not only historical K/V reuse.
W6 enables the LM Head and Decode Attention policies together; their individual full-model contributions were not ablated.
No-KV checks all 256 rows of logits per forward; KV checks all 151936 logits at the current position only.
KV generation does not dump and compare every cache tensor.
Bitwise equality is established between the two KV implementations for France only; matching uncached tokens does not imply bitwise-equal logits.
Stage times overlap by containment and must not be added to their enclosing totals.
KV optimized memory samples cover three cases, while baselines cover France only; no memory reduction ratio is claimed.
RSS observations have sampling gaps and may count shared pages twice; preserve each group's quality fields.
Original independent 256-query Attention score MatMul still has not reached the 1.5x target.
